pkgmetadata.longdescription: The L4T community (Azkali) L4T 4.9 kernel for the Nintendo Switch: the kernel, nvidia, nvgpu and device tree repositories fetched one by one at pinned commits and combined into one kernel tree as Lakka does. make dtbs also makes nx-plat.dtimg, the device trees U-Boot loads.

use.flag: Point /usr/src/linux at these sources when installing them
